author: Anders Johnson
message: Interesting analogy. My only dispute is with the thought that skilled consultants might be more likely to care about your forest's health in the long term, vis-a-vis permanent employees, as the latter are more likely to be with you in the far future, and thereby might have more present incentive to invest in the quality of present work as they might expect to be liable for its future consequences.
